WORKSHOP RULES
✓ CorrectOne robot component is installed.
✕ WrongThe current task is delayed. No part added.
50% to surviveAt least 15/30 correct answers.

Stage thresholds: 5/8 for OS, 6/10 for modelling, and 7/12 for assembly. OS failure causes a glitch, modelling failure deforms the shell, and motherboard failure destroys the robot. Falling below 15/30 causes the overall explosion regardless of stage.

Question source: Cangcut Test Bank.pdf. This game uses 8 Software, 10 Algorithms & Data Structures, and 12 Symbolic AI multiple-choice questions. No True/False or open-ended questions are included.
